snippet.title: Sonic Only Up
snippet.description:
Or, Sonic Can Go Only Up, short trailer. Demo out NOW! At SAGE 2025!
https://sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/sonic-only-up.2685/




Alright so for some more extra details, this is a Sonic the Hedgehog fangame, inspired by Getting Over It, Jump King, Only Up, Get to Work, all those sorta games. Difficult, annoying, and frustrating. Gonna scream and shout out all the swear words there is (and kids, if this is indeed marked as For Kids by YT, feel free to go google a list of swear words). Have fun.

I'm hoping to see some gameplay from others, especially with commentary. Will help me adjust things and gauge difficulty better.
